source.title: The 12 checks before an n8n workflow goes live

thesis: Most n8n workflows fail silently because nobody checks retries, error handling, backups and alerts before handoff.
audience: automation freelancers and agency owners in India

insights.text: A workflow that fails without an alert is not automation, it is a liability.
Retries without a backoff strategy turn one failure into five duplicate writes.
UnAuthenticated webhooks are the most common production hole in client builds.
Pinned data in an exported workflow can leak a real customer record.
A backup nobody tested is a hope, not a backup.
The handoff checklist is the product; the workflow is just the artifact.
